record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: CROCONAW, FERALIGATR and GUZZLORD (the queued units). TOTODILE also declares CRUNCH and is covered by the pilot record; it is not part of this candidate.
record.summary: Single-target special damage (80 raw at 2 stars, 160 raw at 3 stars); if that hit reports death, the caster heals ceil(50% of the victim's max HP) (before handleHeal modifiers and the missing-HP cap). GUZZLORD additionally has an on-kill passive that can trigger from the kill.

effects.scaling: requested amount: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (6th argument apBoost = true); crit multiplier only if the cast crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: applied amount: then the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF), ceil, min 1) and later modifiers in handleDamage; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (death false, no heal). The kill heal does not use the damage dealt or takenDamage, only the victim's max HP

effects.condition: only when handleSpecialDamage reports death for that hit

declaredRaw.note: requested amount; depends on the victim's max HP, not on stars or on damage dealt

effects.scaling: none: apBoost 0 and crit false are passed, so AP and crit do not scale this heal
effects.resolution: applied amount: PokemonState.handleHeal: nothing if the caster is wounded or at 0 hp or protected; x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather; rounded and capped at the caster's missing HP

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars (pokemon.stars - 1); the 4-star entry 320 and the fallback 320 are not reached by these units' bare star counts (2, 3, 3). maxPP is 100 and range 1 for all three.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond needing a target in the caster's range.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept: each cast is independent and the heal can happen on any cast that kills. No modes. For GUZZLORD the passive's on-kill effect is separate and can also fire from this ability's kill.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested (raw) damage: 80 (CROCONAW, 2 stars) / 160 (FERALIGATR and GUZZLORD, 3 stars). Applied damage = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then the SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and later handleDamage modifiers; takenDamage (which includes shield damage) is not used by this ability. Heal: requested ceil(0.5 x victim maxHP) on a reported kill; received heal after the handleHeal modifiers and the missing-HP cap.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (shields, items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection) - only the SPECIAL speDef division and the minimum of 1 were read

guzzlordPassive.summary: GUZZLORD (passive GUZZLORD): an OnKillEffect that does something only if the attacker holds CHEF_HAT (+5 AP, +10 max HP, +1 stack; doubled to 10/20/2 with Gourmet synergy trigger >= 2). Any kill, including a CRUNCH kill, reaches it through triggerDeath -> attacker.onKill -> getEffects(OnKillEffect).
